method: Purposive 10-posting, 10-employer sample across product evals, model evals and eval infrastructure. Nine full primary descriptions inspected (Ashoka is a PDF, not proof of current vacancy), one employer-indexed Workday description whose live rendering was empty. Skill counts combine duties and requirements and are not market prevalence. Do not treat frontier-lab pay as typical graduate pay.
